description: Verify that Main Phase OfferService cyclic gap == cyclic_offer_delay ± tolerance (SOME/IP-SD §4.2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
After Repetition Phase, DUT enters Main Phase emitting OfferService at fixed cyclic_offer_delay. The cadence is the spec invariant.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in Main Phase (after Repetition Phase).
2. Observation: DUT → Tester: cyclic OfferService #1 → #2.
3. Δt(#2,#1) ≈ cyclic_offer_delay (within tolerance).

[Pass condition]
Gap matches cyclic_offer_delay ± tolerance.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_phase2_no_first_main_offer — first main offer missing
• Fail_phase3_no_second_main_offer — second main offer missing
• Fail_phase3_cyclic_out_of_tolerance — gap out of bounds

verdicts.Pass: Main phase cyclic gap matches cyclic_offer_delay — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_first_main_offer: No first main phase offer within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_second_main_offer: No second main phase offer within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_cyclic_out_of_tolerance: Cyclic offer gap not within cyclic_offer_delay tolerance
